description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Engineering product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Change Management).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Engineering.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Engineering. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 8.8 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).
